# Hamilton Marketing Services

> SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, web design and Google Ads for businesses in Hamilton, Ontario and nearby (Stoney Creek, Ancaster, Dundas, Waterdown, Binbrook, Burlington, Grimsby). Based in Etobicoke, Toronto; works with clients by phone, email and video call. Plain-English reporting.

- Phone: (647) 982-2545
- Email: kirill.s.anikin@gmail.com

## Services

- [Local SEO](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/local-seo/): Local SEO for Hamilton businesses: a tuned Business Profile, steady reviews, clean listings and service-area pages that win the map pack. Free audit.
- [Google Business Profile](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/google-business-profile-optimization/): Google Business Profile optimization for Hamilton businesses: the right categories, real services, photos, posts and reviews, within Google's rules.
- [Technical SEO](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/technical-seo/): Technical SEO for Hamilton businesses: we find and fix what stops Google indexing, reading and ranking your site. Speed, redirects, schema. Free audit.
- [SEO Audit](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/seo-audit/): An SEO audit for Hamilton businesses that ends in a to-do list. We check your site, Business Profile and rankings, then send the fixes that matter most.
- [SEO Content Writing](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/content-marketing/): SEO content writing for Hamilton businesses: one page per service, built around what customers really search and ask. Service pages first, then the blog.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/ai-search-optimization/): AI search optimization for Hamilton businesses: clear facts, schema and quotable answers, so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews can name you.
- [Web design](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/web-design/): Web design in Hamilton, Ontario for local businesses: fast sites with one page per service, built to rank on Google, and redesigns that keep your rankings.
- [Google Ads](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/google-ads/): Google Ads for Hamilton service businesses. Conversion tracking first, ads matched to each service, and plain reports on calls and cost per lead.
- [Ecommerce SEO](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/ecommerce-seo/): Ecommerce SEO for small Hamilton online stores: category and product pages that rank, duplicate content fixed, and product schema done right.
- [SEO consultant](https://hamiltonseoservices.ca/seo-consultant/): Work with an SEO expert in Hamilton on strategy, audits and second opinions. For businesses with in-house staff who need direction, not a full retainer.
